description_en: Queries the 5G messaging compatibility of multiple phone numbers in a synchronous batch request
description_zh: 批量同步查询终端对5G消息的适配情况
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi query-rcs-mobile-capable --sign-name '阿里云5G消息' --template-code RCS_SMS_10001052 --phone-numbers 18868100001,18868100002,18868100003 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRCSMobileCapable

parameters.help_en: The list of phone numbers to query. Only 11-digit phone numbers without area codes are supported. Separate multiple phone numbers with commas (,). A maximum of 100 phone numbers are supported
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的手机号列表。仅支持11位手机号，不带区号。多个手机号用英文逗号分隔，最多支持100个手机号
parameters.name: phone_numbers
